{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ma hakotzil ca chacanacentii (do not marvel that I resemble him) -> \"Do not be afraid that I appear to you\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["ù ꝑel mehen: 'only' in 'only Son' is dropped (\"Christ, the Son\")"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["bai tun Xitħic û pectzil û lobil û beel (so the rumour of his wicked ways spread) -> \"and so his evil ways grew worse\"", "maix tan û Kantal û yatal tauol uchic â chichcuntic â puczikal (the grief in your heart will not end, because you hardened your heart) -> \"you will find no time in your heart, because you harden your heart\"", "tacitac û tuculic (he immediately thought) -> \"whenever he thought of it\"", "u yatal tin Uol ù Zatal Uinicoob (the grief in my heart over the loss of mankind) -> \"had great love in my heart for lost mankind\"", "ù noc kixob (a garment of thorns) -> \"crowned with thorns\" (the note gives the correct sense)"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is complete and accurate apart from one slip in Christ's reply, while B gets several passages wrong (the rumour spreading, the warning about the brother's coming grief, and the grief over mankind's loss) and drops 'only' from 'only Son'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["loves (in \"as Christ loves the Church\")", "besides these"], "mistranslated": ["like the Church and Christ (comparison of the relationship) -> as Christ loves the Church (adds a verb not in the source)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["as (treating) the children of God -> Just as God acts toward His children", "what does it forbid, namely not killing (báax cú uethic chucanil éma leti má cimzah) -> what does it completely forbid, namely, not to kill (adds 'completely', awkward)"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both are complete, but B gets the masters-to-servants answer wrong (God treating His children instead of masters treating servants as God's children), while A only adds a small gloss ('loves') to the Church-and-Christ comparison."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["the clause saying the explanation makes the soul tremble with terror and the blood run cold ('leti uol hach heɔáan cú cilƀa, iix cù xiƀil ú kikel')"], "added": ["\"show irreverence\""], "mistranslated": ["sign of the approach of this great tribulation is the seeing of the abomination -> 'the very firm thought being spoken of here... these great tribulations are the sight'", "in haste (zeƀchilah) -> 'in parable'", "sin of profaning God in his temples -> 'sin which kindles God's wrath in his temples'", "today he intends to make you see, as a lord and loving one -> 'as you see, fathers and loved ones'", "asking of your son the graces -> 'grant me, as I ask you, the graces'", "that they may answer me from the heart -> 'grant my listeners to understand it with the heart'", "Forgiver of sins (Ahzáat-zah zipil) -> 'offended Savior'", "good ways (tiƀilƀeilóob) -> 'affronts'", "beyond doubt (xmá ú capelcuntáal) -> 'cannot be counted'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["when you see... you flee (2nd person plural) -> 'when we happen to see... let us flee'", "in all his tribulations -> 'in all their grievous afflictions'", "the sense of 'today he intends to show you' is slightly muddled in the clause about how Christians behave in the churches"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B renders the sermon closely, including the terror clause, 'in haste', 'profaning', 'asking your child' and 'Forgiver of sins'; A drops a clause and misreads many key words."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Bay ti hun hatzul (as at a single stroke) -> 'In like manner, where they were seated'", "ti cá unchaci tioklal napzah uaiix tá kaholticéex (what happens through habit or what you know) -> 'so that it may serve to correct what you already recognize'", "ti máax cú talel ú ɔá zipil (to whom you come to give occasion of sin) -> 'whereby occasions of sin arise'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["hach nohochil hatzul ti le kulnaéex (in the greater part of your churches) reduced to 'in the temple'", "tancaƀ (the courtyard) of the temple"], "added": ["Our offended Savior was greatly angered at this."], "mistranslated": ["Ahzáat-zah (Forgiver/Redeemer) -> 'offended Savior'", "Ahzáat-zah zipil (Forgiver of sins) -> 'offended Savior'", "napzah uaiix tá kaholticéex (through habit or what you know) -> 'through custom or through ignorance'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the source more closely and makes only small slips; B turns the Maya title for the Forgiver into 'offended Savior', adds a line about his anger, and narrows 'most of your churches' to 'the temple'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'iix taɔmanzahóob' (and avarice/greed) is not rendered as a separate forbidden thing"], "added": ["\"through dishonest means\""], "mistranslated": ["desire wealth for good ends and in a right way -> \"other than for a good purpose\" (reverses the sense)", "by a separate commandment (pelelil almahtħan) -> \"by these commandments\"", "their thoughts and impulses are themselves evil -> \"from them arise evil thoughts and evil inclinations\""]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the catechism's sense closely all the way through, while B gets the first question backwards, drops 'separate' commandment and blurs the avarice clause."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["you hear Mass often"], "mistranslated": ["since Mass is spoken of (u yabal misa) -> Since you hear Mass often", "infinite Lord (h maxulunté Yum) -> Most High Lord", "to return love/thanks (zut-zah yacunahóob) -> to give him thanks for his benefits", "whom do the Masses benefit (nahinticóob) -> For whom are the Masses offered", "commemoration (kahzahul) -> representation"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the Maya closely throughout, while B misreads several key words: it gives 'Most High' for maxulunté ('infinite'), 'offered' for nahintic ('benefit'), 'benefits' for yacunah ('love'), and adds 'you hear Mass often' to the second question."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["tu coꜭhih ('will be fulfilled/completed', uncertain) -> 'it will truly be completed for one' (the word 'truly' is padding)", "ꜭhipe ru ꜭhoh mil vae (sense uncertain) -> 'how this is to be used' (tentative)", "ꜫihalonic (uncertain) -> 'with prayer' (flagged in a note as tentative)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ah ahil ('eager/desirous', to weep) is not rendered"], "added": ["Even if", "while", "it is fitting that"], "mistranslated": ["tu coꜭhih ('will be fulfilled') -> 'he shall take patience'", "ru nima ho yeuaxic ('its great indulgence/forgiveness') -> 'it is greatly to be honored'", "ru vaꜭh ('its fruit') -> 'its presence'", "ah ghumum, ah ꜫatat gux ('fervent, hot of heart') -> 'proud, hard-hearted'", "ah biꜯ ('sorrowful') -> 'songsters, merrymakers'", "ti giꜯ ruꜫaꜭh Padre ('we go before the Father') -> 'while the Father Priest is giving absolution'", "ꜭhibiꜯ ('with sorrow') -> 'with hymns'", "ki ti vagaxah ('we must know') -> 'what you should hear'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A gives a coherent reading of the page's call to fervent, sorrowful confession and penance, while B turns key words into near-opposites ('proud, hard-hearted', 'songsters', 'hymns') and adds a concessive frame that is not in the source."}
